forest_glass_3 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_1_year
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 5
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		has_building_or_higher = charcoal_production_3
	
            }
        }
    }
	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		has_building_or_higher = charcoal_production_3
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_3_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = forest_glass_income_tier_3
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = forest_glass_income_tier_3_tribal
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood #Uses Wood to make Glass
		amount = major_basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 3
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_glass_production_add = forest_glass_output_per_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = monthly_tax_per_glass_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = monthly_tax_per_glass_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = forest_glass_4
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_glass }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_wood }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_glass }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 3 }
	}
}

hunting_lodges_1 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		building_requirement_meat_allowed = yes
	
            }
        }
    }

	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = hunting_lodges_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = hunting_lodges_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_meat_production_add = meat_output_from_wood_per_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = monthly_tax_per_meat_from_wood_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = monthly_tax_per_meat_from_wood_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = hunting_lodges_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/meat_buildings.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_meat CATEGORY = trade_category_meat }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_wood }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_cured_meat_producer_modifier = { VALUE = ai_building_priority_soft }
		ai_market_category_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_meat CATEGORY = trade_category_meat }
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}

firewood_collection_1 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_cheap_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = firewood_income_tier_1 #Woodland Income
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = firewood_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	trade_good_need = { #Raw Material
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				monthly_province_size_change_when_below_baseline_add = 0.2
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = firewood_collection_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/wood_buildings.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_wood }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}

			}
			province_government_modifier = {

				monthly_woodland_tax = monthly_tax_per_lacquerware_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal

			}

		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_lacquerware_production_mult = lacquerware_mult_per_dyes
				woodland_tax_mult = tax_mult_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = lacquerware_workshop_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/lacquerware_workshop.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10

	}
